label: Bento dashboard
desc: A bento-grid dashboard with mixed-size tiles: revenue sparkline with count-up and scrubber, radial goal gauge, activity heatmap, task checklist, week strip with events and top-product bars; tiles lift on hover and fly in once.
use: admin dashboard home, shop overview, analytics landing for a signed-in owner

label: Messaging dashboard
desc: A customer inbox with open/pending/closed tabs, search, unread badges, a thread where you type and send (auto reply with typing dots), status chips and a customer details panel with plan, tags and orders.
use: support inbox, customer messages page, contact form replies in a dashboard

label: Project dashboard
desc: A team project board: project sidebar, avatar stack, three kanban columns where cards move by buttons, keyboard or pointer drag, a live progress ring, milestone gantt and per-person workload bars.
use: team workspace, build/launch tracker, content calendar planning page
